data.long_meaning: Ravi means sun and Shankara is a name of Lord Shiva. The name Ravishankar signifies the presence of the sun god and the power of Lord Shiva. The name Ravishankar carries the meaning “God Shankara” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ravishankar usually hope their child will grow to embody god shankara and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ravishankar is a combination of two Sanskrit words - 'Ravi' and 'Shankara'. 'Ravi' is derived from 'Ravi' which means 'Sun' in Sanskrit, and 'Shankara' is an epithet of Lord Shiva. In ancient Hindu culture, the sun was considered the source of life and energy, while Lord Shiva was revered as the divine ascetic, the supreme being beyond all forms and manifestations. The name Ravishankar symbolizes the coming together of these two powerful divine entities.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, the sun represents the source of all life, energy, and consciousness, while Lord Shiva is considered the supreme consciousness and the ultimate reality. The name Ravishankar denotes the embodiment of this supreme reality and the divine power of creation and destruction. It is a reminder that we are all children of the sun and the manifestation of the divine Lord Shiva. The name carries a deep spiritual significance, reminding us of our divine origin and the sacred nature of our existence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Ravishankar: Radiant and captivating Shiva, who enchants and transports the soul towards the ultimate truth.

historical_references.reference: Ravishankar was an influential Indian music composer, musician and singer, widely regarded as a pioneer of Indian classical music fusion with Western styles. He is best known for popularizing the fusion genre, which he called 'Indo-Jazz-Fusion'. He was born on July 10, 1945 in Tamil Nadu, India.
historical_references.context: Music and Fusion of Eastern and Western musical styles

historical_references.reference: Ravishankar was also a renowned spiritual leader and the guru of famous sitar player Ravi Shankar. He was a disciple of Sri Aurobindo and the Mother and spent many years in meditation and spiritual practice at the Aurobindo Ashram in Puducherry, India. Ravishankar was born on July 10, 1916 in Karnataka, India.
